rendered:
The question's premise does not hold. The document does not report NFA-F as having the best capacity retention; it reports the opposite, with NFA-A as the best. The NFA-A variant had[1] ≈80%[2] capacity retention after 100 cycles[3], versus NFA 811[4] at ≈70%[5]. NFA-F was the lowest, at ≈50%[6], and the same ranking appears in Fig. 8[7].

The document gives no causal explanation for NFA-F's low retention. It notes other weaknesses of NFA-F: it has the lowest aluminum content of the NFA variants (5% Al[8]), its redox couple (≈4.0 V[9]) was depressed (was depressed in the NFA-F variant[10]), and at high rate it delivered a low capacity (NFA-F variant delivered a low capacity[11]). These are observations about the variants, not stated reasons for the retention result.
